response.sql: WITH counted AS (SELECT o.recordvault, o.orderflow, COUNT(*) as count FROM riskandmargin rm INNER JOIN orders o ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow), totals_by_status AS (SELECT orderflow, SUM(count) as total_count FROM counted GROUP BY orderflow), with_shares AS (SELECT c.recordvault, c.orderflow, c.count, CAST(c.count AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.total_count AS DECIMAL) as share FROM counted c JOIN totals_by_status t ON c.orderflow = t.orderflow), status_averages AS (SELECT orderflow, AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares GROUP BY orderflow), with_gaps AS (SELECT ws.recordvault, ws.orderflow, ws.count, ws.share, ws.share - sa.avg_share as gap FROM with_shares ws JOIN status_averages sa ON ws.orderflow = sa.orderflow) SELECT recordvault, orderflow, count, share, gap FROM with_gaps ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10
